tei:div.tei:p: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gter gyi bdag po dregs pa sde lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ shu la tri dza: oṃ de ba a dza: oṃ dha sha ghṛ ba du dza: oṃ nā ga rā dza nāṃ dza: oṃ dh+wa ti ku ma ra bai dza: hūm̐/ sngon tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga ru// zab gter srung mar zhal bzhes dam tshig can// mthu chen gter gyi bdag po chen po rnams/ rang rang g.yog 'khor bcas pa 'dir gshegs shig /ni dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ ni dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shu la rā dza de ba rā dza dha sha ghṛ wa nā ga rā dza dh+wa ti ku ma ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan gsum dang*/ ma hā pañca a mṛta khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta khā hiḥ zab gter srung ma'i dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol/ sems can gyi phan bde spel/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sdongs grogs mdzod/ sngags 'chang rnams kyi phrin las sgrubs/ sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs choms/ khyad par dam tshig 'dir 'dus pa rnams kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang/ mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces phrin las bcol la/ bstod bskul ni/ hūm̐: shu ba srog zan btsan gyi rje: zhes sogs brjod pa gzhung ltar ro// byin rlabs 'dod gsol rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin zla ming pas bris pa 'phel 'gyur cig// /
